"""Disposable qualification control: remove a restored protected-column comment."""
import importlib


def pytest_configure(config):
    reverse = importlib.import_module('cryptalis.deprotection')
    migration = importlib.import_module('cryptalis.migration')
    original = reverse._restore_metadata

    def lose_comment(connection, plan, model):
        original(connection, plan, model)
        for name in model.get('source_metadata', {}).get('columns', {}):
            column = migration._quote(connection, name)
            table = migration._table(connection, model)
            connection.exec_driver_sql(f'COMMENT ON COLUMN {table}.{column} IS NULL')
    reverse._restore_metadata = lose_comment
